label: Paris
description: I moved to Paris in 2019 for my studies and quickly made it home. The city's pace and energy suit me well, balancing work, sports, and everyday life.

label: Ultranoir
description: In 2022, I joined Ultranoir for a 6-month internship where I worked on production-level projects and deepened my React expertise. The team's mentorship on professional workflows directly influenced my decision to build this portfolio with Next.js.

label: Football
description: Lifelong football fan. I played competitively throughout my youth and still play regularly with friends. PSG supporter.

label: Sailing
description: I sailed from age 8 to 18 in Saint-Raphael, progressing through pico, catamaran, and ludic classes. I reached FFV level 4 and nearly became a certified summer instructor.

label: Dreamline Studio
description: In the summer of 2021, I completed a remote internship at Dreamline Studio, strengthening my WordPress skills. I've continued collaborating with them as a freelancer since.

label: Cairo
description: Born and raised in Cairo, I attended the French Lycee before moving to France. I visit regularly, speak Arabic fluently, and value the adaptability that comes from growing up across cultures.

label: Karate
description: I practiced karate from age 5 to 17 in Egypt under the same sensei, training two to three times a week. I earned my first-dan black belt.

label: HETIC
description: Graduate of HETIC, a program combining web development, design, and communication. While specializing in development, I maintained a strong focus on design and cross-functional collaboration to understand every facet of a product.

label: Piano
description: I studied piano for several years at the Russian Cultural Center in Egypt. Somewhere on YouTube, there's a video of little Soliman performing.

label: Aikido
description: Alongside karate, I trained in Aikido with the same sensei. Its core philosophy, redirecting an opponent's energy rather than opposing it, shaped my approach to problem-solving beyond the mat.

label: Three.js Journey
description: I completed most of the Three.js Journey course, building solid foundations in creating interactive 3D experiences for the web.

label: Canada
description: In 2023, I spent six months in Montreal working at LG2, focusing on UI architecture, animations, and high-performance frontend systems. This experience sharpened my skills in software design and technical precision.

label: Languages
description: Fluent in French (native), English, and Arabic. A natural asset for collaborating with international teams and clients across markets.

label: Sparkles AI
description: In 2025, I co-founded Sparkles AI, an AI-driven web platform built with Next.js, Supabase, and Cloudflare. The project pushed me into system scalability, caching strategies, and user memory architectures powered by vector search.

label: Travel & Exploration
description: Discovering new cultures and places has always fueled my creativity. I'm open to relocating abroad, especially to the U.S., to keep growing both personally and professionally.

label: Wiz
description: Since 2024, I've been working at Wiz Media as a full-stack developer, contributing across frontend and backend. My focus areas include performance optimization, scalable architectures, and API design using Next.js and Storyblok.
